doc.name: EcoCheck Assistant
doc.description: EcoCheck (by BeevR) is a Vietnamese greenhouse-gas inventory platform and service: Scope 1/2/3 calculation, reports under Decree 06/2022 – Circular 38 and ISO 14064, CBAM and ESG. This endpoint gives read-only access to its obligation checker, EU CBAM calculators (scope check, default values, certificate cost), an ISO 14064-1 GHG inventory calculator and guide, 2026 regulations, services, pricing and Vietnamese articles. Send a question as text (Vietnamese or English); the agent replies with an obligation check, regulations, services or articles (read-only, deterministic, no LLM).

skills.name: Kiểm tra nghĩa vụ kiểm kê khí nhà kính
skills.description: Answers whether a Vietnamese facility must do a mandatory GHG inventory (Decree 06/2022, Decision 42/2026) from its sector and annual energy/emissions, and states the 31/3/2027 deadline.
examples: Nhà máy dệt dùng 15 triệu kWh điện mỗi năm có phải kiểm kê khí nhà kính không?
Does a cement plant emitting 5,000 tCO2e/year need a GHG inventory in Vietnam?

skills.name: Kiến thức kiểm kê KNK, CBAM, thị trường carbon
skills.description: Finds EcoCheck services, 2026 regulations and Vietnamese articles on GHG inventory, Scope 1/2/3, CBAM, carbon credits and ESG.
examples: CBAM 2027 doanh nghiệp xuất khẩu cần làm gì?
